query: SELECT p.id FROM payment_attempts p WHERE ((p.provider='paypal' AND p.tenant=ANY($1)) OR p.provider=ANY($2)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_jobs j WHERE j.tenant=p.tenant AND j.attempt_id=p.id AND j.available_at<=now() AND (j.state='queued' OR j.state='running' AND j.lease_until<now())) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_jobs j WHERE j.tenant=p.tenant AND j.attempt_id=p.id AND j.state='running' AND j.lease_until>now()) ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF p SKIP LOCKED
